// Get user message
const userMessage = $input.first().json.user_query;

// === SEARCH FUNCTION ===
function searchArticles(query) {
  const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
  const results = [];
  
  // 1. ARTICLE NUMBER SEARCH - extract any number pattern like 327.1, 327, 346.1.3 etc.
  // Normalize: replace all dashes with dots first
  const normalized = q.replace(/-/g, '.');
  
  // Match patterns like: maddə 327.1, 327.1, madde 327, article 327.1.1
  const articlePattern = /(?:madd[əe]\s*)?\b(\d{2,3}(?:\.\d{1,2}){0,3})\b/gi;
  const matches = [...normalized.matchAll(articlePattern)];
  
  if (matches.length > 0) {
    for (const match of matches) {
      const searchId = match[1];
      // Exact match first
      const exact = articles.filter(a => a.id === searchId);
      if (exact.length > 0) {
        results.push(...exact);
      } else {
        // Prefix match: searching "327" should return 327.1, 327.2, etc.
        const prefix = articles.filter(a => a.id === searchId || a.id.startsWith(searchId + '.'));
        results.push(...prefix);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 2. KEYWORD SEARCH if no article number found
  if (results.length === 0) {
    const keywords = {
      'sürət|speed|fast|km': ['328'],
      'alkoqol|alcohol|drunk|dui|sərxoş|içki': ['333', '334'],
      'narkotik|drug|psixotrop': ['333.1', '334.1'],
      'lisenziya|license|vəsiqə|hüququ olmadan': ['332'],
      'kəmər|seatbelt|belt': ['329.1'],
      'dəbilqə|helmet': ['329.2'],
      'işıq|light': ['329.3'],
      'parking|parklanma|park': ['346.1'],
      'dayanma|stop|durma': ['346'],
      'piyada|pedestrian|crosswalk|keçid': ['330', '338'],
      'svetofor|qırmızı|red light|traffic light': ['327.2'],
      'dəmiryol|railway': ['327.3'],
      'birtərəfli|one.way|wrong.way|əks istiqamət': ['327.4'],
      'nişan|sign|işarə': ['327.1'],
      'sığorta|insurance': ['469'],
      'telefon|phone|mobil': ['342.6'],
      'səs|exhaust|egzoz|muffler|loud': ['342.3'],
      'yarış|racing|wheelie|hooligan|xuliqan|drift|burnout': ['511'],
      'təcili|emergency|ambulance': ['331'],
      'müayinə|test|breathalyzer|imtina': ['343'],
      'qeydiyyat|registration|nişan|plate': ['339', '342.7'],
      'texniki|technical|tormoz|brake|sükan|steering': ['342.2'],
      'tint|örtük|şüşə': ['342.2'],
      'dərman qutusu|first aid|tibbi': ['356'],
      'təhlükəli yük|hazardous|dangerous cargo': ['348'],
      'velosiped|bicycle|moped': ['338.4'],
      'elektrik|scooter|e.scooter': ['338.4.1'],
      'hadisə|accident|yayınma': ['327.6'],
      'bal|point|20 bal': ['327.7'],
      'cərimə ödəmə|pay fine|529': ['529']
    };
    
    const matchedIds = new Set();
    for (const [pattern, ids] of Object.entries(keywords)) {
      const regex = new RegExp(pattern, 'i');
      if (regex.test(q)) {
        ids.forEach(id => matchedIds.add(id));
      }
    }
    
    for (const id of matchedIds) {
      const matched = articles.filter(a => a.id === id || a.id.startsWith(id + '.'));
      results.push(...matched);
    }
  }
  
  // 3. FALLBACK: full-text search
  if (results.length === 0) {
    const queryWords = q.split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 3);
    for (const article of articles) {
      const text = (article.id + ' ' + article.description).toLowerCase();
      if (queryWords.some(w => text.includes(w))) {
        results.push(article);
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Deduplicate by id
  const seen = new Set();
  const unique = results.filter(a => {
    if (seen.has(a.id)) return false;
    seen.add(a.id);
    return true;
  });
  
  return unique.slice(0, 10);
}
